description.short: Deploy and manage sites, apps, databases and domains on agenthost.
description.full: Agent-first web hosting inside Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork. Create projects, deploy apps from a GitHub repo or an upload, attach databases, manage custom domains and environment variables, read deploy logs, and roll back — all through the agenthost MCP connector. Sign in once in the browser; there is no API key to paste.
